name: Neue Nix Hashes berechnen
command: cd /tmp/t3code-sync-20260909 && for package in unwrapped server; do NP_LOCATION=/tmp/t3-nix-home /tmp/nix-portable nix build --impure --no-link --print-build-logs --expr "let flake = builtins.getFlake \"git+file:///tmp/t3code-sync-20260909\"; in flake.packages.x86_64-linux.$package.pnpmDeps.overrideAttrs (_: { outputHash = \"sha256-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=\"; })" > "/tmp/t3-sync-nix-$package.log" 2>&1; code=$?; echo "$package exit=$code"; grep -E 'specified:|got:' "/tmp/t3-sync-nix-$package.log" | tail -2; done
description: Calculate dependency hashes for the rebased fork
